methods.summary: This study measured five morphological traits (Weber’s length, relative eye length, relative scape length, relative mandible length, and relative hindleg length) and other measurements (head length, width, eye width, and pronotum width) on worker ants to conduct functional diversity analyses. The study measured functional alpha and beta diversity, as well as species richness, for ant communities across different sampling locations.

discussion.summary: The study measured ant species richness and functional diversity indices across three transects in different regions, observing patterns related to elevation and latitude.
